author: N6rL
content: Blocked by L2 (skeleton must exist so CLAUDE.md can reference real paths). Scope: (1) CLAUDE.md at repo root — a brief agent-orientation document that covers: what the project is (one paragraph, pointing to .design/ALCANZAI.md), the polyglot split and which layer lives where (pointing to DESIGN.md §9.2), how to use the prototype/ reference (pointing to .design/PROTOTYPE.md), the crosslink rules summary (pointing to .crosslink/rules/), how to run the test suites (uv run pytest and cargo test), and where to find the current milestone (crosslink issue tree). CLAUDE.md should be readable in under 2 minutes — it is a map, not a manual. (2) Devcontainer or equivalent: a .devcontainer/devcontainer.json (or Dockerfile + setup script) so environment setup — uv, Python 3.14, Rust toolchain, GROBID container — is not per-session friction. AC: a new agent session reading only CLAUDE.md can locate the design docs, run the test suites, and find the current milestone without additional orientation; devcontainer builds successfully.
